advisories.principle: No model liquidity, no strategic dependency.
advisories.finding: The system depends on a single model provider and cannot switch with low friction.
advisories.action: Add model-agnostic routing and a documented exit path to restore negotiating leverage.

hard_gate_failures.law: No granular permissions, no tool access.
hard_gate_failures.finding: An agent has tool or data access without granular, role/classification/purpose-based permissions.
hard_gate_failures.action: Define and enforce agent permissions before granting tool, data, or action access.

hard_gate_failures.law: No rollback path, no autonomous action.
hard_gate_failures.finding: System takes autonomous actions without branching, rollback, or reversibility.
hard_gate_failures.action: Restrict the system to human-in-the-loop, or implement branch-before-commit with rollback.

hard_gate_failures.finding: S4 (sovereign / core institutional knowledge) workload runs on contractual-only assurance.
hard_gate_failures.action: Move S4 workloads to owned hardware or attested compute. Contracts are not isolation.

hard_gate_failures.finding: No accountable owner is assigned to this AI system.
hard_gate_failures.action: Assign a named accountable owner before any deployment or continued use.

hard_gate_failures.finding: System is not fully recorded in the AI system inventory.
hard_gate_failures.action: Complete the inventory record: purpose, data touched, models, providers, integrations.

hard_gate_failures.law: No ZDR or equivalent protection, no sensitive data.
hard_gate_failures.finding: Sensitive data (S2+) flows to an external model without confirmed ZDR or structural compute assurance.
hard_gate_failures.action: Confirm a zero-data-retention agreement, move the workload to structural assurance (owned or attested compute), or downgrade the data sent.

hard_gate_failures.finding: Provider training on institutional/customer data is not contractually prohibited for an S2+ workload.
hard_gate_failures.action: Obtain a contractual prohibition on training with institutional and customer data before S2+ use.

hard_gate_failures.law: No audit trail, no production agent.
hard_gate_failures.finding: S2+ workload runs without append-only audit logging of initiator, prompt, model, data accessed, and result.
hard_gate_failures.action: Enable audit logging that can replay any decision and answer 'who touched what' before continued use.

advisories.principle: ZDR alone is not enough — review derived metadata.
advisories.finding: Retention of derived metadata (classifier outputs, monitoring logs, telemetry) has not been reviewed.
advisories.action: Review provider terms for metadata and telemetry retention that falls outside content-only ZDR language.

advisories.principle: No model liquidity, no strategic dependency.
advisories.finding: The system depends on a single model provider and cannot switch with low friction.
advisories.action: Add model-agnostic routing and a documented exit path to restore negotiating leverage.

advisories.finding: No documented routing decision (sensitivity -> assurance -> model path) exists for this workload.
advisories.action: Record a model routing decision using templates/ai-model-routing-record.md.

advisories.principle: No owned context layer, no compounding institutional knowledge.
advisories.finding: Workflow signal and know-how are captured inside a provider's system, not an organization-owned context layer.
advisories.action: Capture decisions, actions, and structured context in an ontology/knowledge layer the organization owns.
